title: mi_datagram Module
content_markdown: This is a module which provides a UNIX/UDP SOCKET transport layer implementation for the Management Interface.
overview: This is a module which provides a UNIX/UDP SOCKET transport layer implementation for the Management Interface.
how_it_works:
The MI requests and replies follow the [JSON-RPC](http://www.jsonrpc.org/specification) syntax.

If case of an error generated by the MI engine, mostly internal errors, an error message in plain text is sent back in the datagram.

exported_parameters.name: socket_name
exported_parameters.description: The name of a UNIX SOCKET or an IP address. The UNIX datagram or UDP socket will be created using this parameter in order to read the external commands. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

exported_parameters.name: children_count
exported_parameters.description: The number of child processes to be created. Each child process will be a datagram server.

exported_parameters.name: unix_socket_mode
exported_parameters.description: Permission to be used for creating the listening UNIX datagram socket. Not necessary for a UDP socket. It follows the UNIX conventions.

exported_parameters.name: unix_socket_group
exported_parameters.description: Group to be used for creating the listening UNIX socket.

exported_parameters.name: unix_socket_user
exported_parameters.description: User to be used for creating the listening UNIX socket.

exported_parameters.name: socket_timeout
exported_parameters.description: The reply will expire after trying to sent it for socket\_timeout milliseconds.

exported_parameters.name: trace_destination
exported_parameters.description:
Trace destination as defined in the tracing module. Currently the only tracing module is **proto\_hep**. This is where traced mi messages will go.

**WARNING:** A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example **proto\_hep**).

exported_parameters.name: trace_bwlist
exported_parameters.description:
Filter traced mi commands based on a blacklist or a whitelist. **trace\_destination** must be defined for this parameter to have any purpose. Whitelists can be defined using 'w' or 'W', blacklists using 'b' or 'B'. The type is separate by the actual blacklist by ':'. The mi commands in the list must be separated by ','.

Defining a blacklists means all the commands that are not blacklisted will be traced. Defining a whitelist means all the commands that are not whitelisted will not be traced. **WARNING:** One can't define both a whitelist and a blacklist. Only one of them is allowed. Defining the parameter a second time will just overwrite the first one.

**WARNING:** A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example **proto\_hep)**.
exported_parameters.example_code:
...
## blacklist ps and which mi commands
## all the other commands shall be traced
modparam("mi\_datagram", "trace\_bwlist", "b: ps, which")
...
## allow only sip\_trace mi command
## all the other commands will not be traced
modparam("mi\_datagram", "trace\_bwlist", "w: sip\_trace")
...

exported_parameters.name: pretty_printing
exported_parameters.description: Indicates whether the JSONRPC responses sent through MI should be pretty-printed or not.

exported_parameters.name: socket_buf_size
exported_parameters.description: Maximum buffer size used when receiving and sending.
